objective: Bring the glowing fruit to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.

description: Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.
Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
progress: <name>, you look like you have something to tell me. Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
completion: You found this on Teldrassil? Intriguing... this fruit is exotic. Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off. Perhaps even as far as Azeroth! And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.
Thank you, <name>. Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
